name: delivery-run-view
description: A read-only view of delivery runs inside Claude Code, drawn from the run files the surfaces already write: a /flows pane with one row per phase — how it ran (inline, delegate, fork, gate; inferred and marked ? where the run does not record it), agent, model and effort, duration, repeated passes, the sub-agents it delegated to, and the focused phase's output, QA scenarios, links, tokens and tool calls — a band above the prompt while this session's run is open, surface start_run and update_stage calls drawn as one-line phase transitions, the status line set to the flow and its stage, and /flows-demo playing a simulated flow-code run in memory. Function-hook modules, so Claude Code only. Not a surface: it answers no operation, writes nothing, and declares no dependency.
